binary_majority.shares_from: every patient of validate; a subset report keeps these shares

definitions.stats_file: BED's own train statistics, the stats file its code loads (J3')
definitions.counted: the same statistics counted from the train split, every value of a multi-choice evidence counted
definitions.answers: BED's own simulator (`bed.record_findings`), not the protocol's oracle: a categorical or multi-choice question is answered positive whenever the evidence is on the true disease's list, its default value included, so the answer reveals list membership; comparisons with the main policies include this
